w:r.w:t: We take care of your IT, so you can take care of your customers.

From everyday user support to proactive monitoring, maintenance, and security, Nexsate takes responsibility for keeping your IT environment running smoothly. We help resolve issues before they disrupt operations, giving your people the support they need to stay focused on their work.

We believe technology should make business easier, safer, and more productive. At Nexsate, that belief shapes everything we do, from how we understand our customers' needs to how we design, deliver, and support technology that works for their business.
Technology solutions build around the industries we serve.

Different industries depend on technology in different ways. From keeping production systems connected to supporting healthcare teams and business-critical operations, Nexsate delivers IT solutions that reflect the demands, workflows, and priorities of each sector.

w:r.w:t: Nexsate is your trusted source for IT services and support.

Nexsate brings together managed IT, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, software development, and systems integration under one roof, providing businesses with a single, accountable partner for their technology needs.
One team, one point of contact. We take ownership of your IT needs and see issues through to resolution.
We identify recurring issues, anticipate challenges, and recommend improvements for long-term reliability.

A coordinated helpdesk for user requests, backed by device management, updates, and system maintenance. We track issues through resolution and keep your everyday IT administration organized.
We design, migrate, and manage cloud environments, business applications, and data across public, private, and hybrid platforms, covering storage, access, integration, and ongoing administration.
We design, configure, and maintain network switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and remote access, monitoring performance and investigating connectivity faults across your offices, sites, and remote teams.
We develop business applications, implement ERP systems, automate workflows, and integrate software platforms to improve data flow, reduce manual tasks, and simplify business operations.
We protect networks, systems, applications, and data through threat monitoring, access controls, vulnerability management, and incident response to strengthen your organization's security.
We manage backups, test recovery procedures, and plan for restoring critical data and systems, helping businesses recover from outages, data loss, and unexpected disruptions.
